procedure.selection_method: For each pool in selection_order, call randrange(len(pool)) exactly once.

setting: backstage tailoring corridor beside a curtained runway entrance
glass-roofed museum stair landing during a quiet fashion press preview
smoked-mirror hotel gallery outside an evening reception
late-night independent boutique fitting salon between appointments
covered civic-arcade portrait station after rain
optical_structure: a full-height bronze mirror meeting a clear glass partition at a sharp vertical seam
a ribbed-glass divider casting a narrow doubled contour beside the subject
a polished stainless-steel column carrying a compressed secondary reflection
a rain-dark window intersected by a pale stone mullion
a transparent acrylic garment screen crossed by one reflected ceiling strip
layer_pair: an opaque ink-black silk-faille longline bralette-inspired top with architectural cup seams under a separate charcoal wool-mohair cropped blazer
an opaque espresso bonded-jersey bodysuit-inspired foundation with curved torso seams under a separate dove-gray chalk-stripe tuxedo jacket
an opaque ivory satin camisole with wide bound straps and a squared neckline under a separate midnight-navy linen-silk suit jacket
an opaque deep-teal compact-knit bralette-inspired top with a wide underband under a separate dark-chocolate gabardine wrap blazer
an opaque rust silk-twill slip-inspired foundation with shaped bust seams under a separate mulberry dinner jacket with matte faille lapels
action: her right thumb and forefinger draw the lower edge of the jacket's left front panel five centimeters outward while the hem is still settling
her left hand slides the jacket's right lapel edge diagonally toward its fastening point, paused just before the closure meets
her right hand pinches the jacket's left waist edge and guides it inward across the torso, caught midway before fastening
her left thumb smooths the exact lower corner of the jacket's right front edge downward and slightly outward, with the fabric still in motion
her right hand lifts the precise waist-height corner of the jacket's left front edge to settle its overlap, paused before release
light_lens: warm tungsten top light crossed by cool reflected window light, photographed vertically with a 50 mm lens at chest height
cool skylight with one amber reflected strip, photographed vertically with a 58 mm lens at eye level
soft neutral key light plus a copper mirror bounce, photographed vertically with a 45 mm lens at sternum height
diffuse rainy daylight and one warm practical glow, photographed vertically with a 55 mm lens at eye level
clean gallery daylight with a narrow magenta reflection, photographed vertically with a 50 mm lens at upper-torso height

concept_summary: A late-night boutique editorial portrait of an unmistakably adult woman paused while settling the exact left front waist edge of a navy tailored jacket. The lifted edge causally opens a narrow waist interval above high-rise trousers while an opaque, constructed ivory satin camisole remains visibly separate beneath it; a transparent acrylic garment screen adds one controlled reflection.
